summary: Public v2 provider resumes use attempt-scoped replacement call keys under one durable job budget; terminal receipts are never reopened as success.
invariants: Initial semantic call keys stay stable within attempt 1.
Each later workspace attempt gets one attempt-scoped replacement key.
Job-wide request, retry, cost, deadline, and fence budgets remain authoritative.
Non-retryable provider control errors preserve their code and terminate.
forbidden: Reopening a terminal provider receipt as success.
Resetting the durable provider budget on workspace retry.
